name: Broken Promises
source:
You take on the role of Jack Bates, a detective sent undercover to infiltrate a criminal organization with the goal to put an end to their works. Things get complicated when his long-lost-friend and haunted past come back into his life. Making new friends and new enemies; it’s up to you to use your resources, make the hard choices, all while trying your best to keep your promises.​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/broken-promises-ch-2-rework-knightbp.86405]F95Zone[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演侦探Jack Bates，奉命卧底渗透一个犯罪组织，设法终止他们的罪行。当他失散多年的朋友和挥之不去的往事重新闯入生活，事情开始变得复杂。结识新朋友、树立新敌人；你必须善用手头资源，作出艰难选择，同时尽力信守承诺。

[来源：[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/broken-promises-ch-2-rework-knightbp.86405]F95Zone[/url]]
